body: PR #2815 (TASK-1951 slice 3, reconcile) round-1 fixes are in. Head 25fd68b5ddd776e8395a3ab4e4c91d5eed5e1e1c, CI green. (1) aida pr ship now appends 'aida: no-complete' to the squash body when it withholds completion (--no-complete or a PR-body marker). If the identity gate leaves the body to the forge, ship rebuilds it from the commit messages first. (2) A squash subject whose ids sit only in a (Refs …) group now counts as non-completing for the covers path, through refs_completion_filter. The test covers the body marker, a Refs-only subject, and the exact body ship writes. The PR body claim is corrected. PR #2816 round-1 fix pushed at c60de4a0db, CI pending.
